Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner selected A) erosion of the stream bank, based on a niche recession-limb/pore-pressure argument, contradicting the standard principle that as stream velocity decreases, transport capacity and competence decrease and deposition increases. The correct choice is B) deposition of material in the stream; bank erosion, the amount carried, and particle size generally decrease with lower velocity.
